messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT][SLO][eu-west-1] p99 request latency crossed 2.5s threshold for router->lb path. 3.9% p99 breach over last 5m. Streaming stalls observed for some sessions. Auto-paging triggered @oncall.
alex: seeing it too. dashboards show a spike starting 12:13 UTC. tail distribution has a heavy weight at ~4.2s. looks like a few shards are spiking.
priya: tagged as sev2 for now; customers impacted: realtime streaming (websocket) and low-qps inference paths. sample trace IDs incoming in the alert payload.
jordan: this smells like routing policy misassignment again — earlier we saw weight skew when the new heuristic rollout started. any config pushes to routers in last 30m?
sam: no router config pushes from infra in last hour. I do see a dedicated rollout of a new LB heuristic in canary at 11:50 that was promoted at 12:05 to 20%.
alex: can we roll that back to 0% quickly? if it's the heuristic, fallback should help.
priya: agree. alex, are you taking the on-call bridge? I'm paused on production evals.
alex: I'm on bridge. starting rollback of lb-heuristic to previous stable in eu-west-1 canary first.
ops-bot: rollback triggered by alex: POST /api/v1/rollouts/rollback (id: r-7f2d). status: started.
emma: grabbing tail logs for affected routing shards: /logs/router/eu-west-1/12:10-12:20. I’ll paste a small excerpt.
emma: ```
[12:14:33] router: shard=hot-42 steering=heuristic-v2 -> target=zb-88 latency=350ms
[12:14:33] lb: chosen=zb-88 backend-queue=12 length=21 stall=1
[12:14:33] router: shard=hot-42 steering=heuristic-v2 -> target=zb-89 latency=4.1s
[12:14:33] lb: chosen=zb-89 backend-queue=98 stall=1
[12:14:34] router: shard=hot-42 steering=heuristic-v2 -> target=zb-89 latency=4.3s
```
alex: that queue depth on zb-89 is bad. looks like a hotkey feeding a small set of backends. can we drain/evict that backend from the candidate set?
jordan: eviction requires client-aware drain. We can mark zb-89 as avoid for new connections or mark as read-only for streaming. will need a short L7 rule toggle.
sam: I can flip an emergency avoid rule in the LB. prepping command.
sam: command: `POST /lb/v1/policies/avoid` body: {"region":"eu-west-1","backend":"zb-89","reason":"hotkey-queue-evict"}
ops-bot: dry-run check OK. Applying avoid rule.
ops-bot: avoid rule applied: zb-89 now excluded from new routing decisions in eu-west-1.
emma: within 30s we see p99 drop from 4.2s -> 2.1s. p95 stable. streaming stall count decreased by ~60% in the sample group.
priya: good delta. continue rollback of heuristic while monitor. alex, what's ETA on rollback completion?
alex: rollback to 0% promoted in ~eu-west-1 completed at 12:22. global rollback queued. monitoring.
jordan: also seeing cross-region spillover: traffic from eu-west-1 being routed to eu-central and us-west for some sessions — that added latency for streaming handshakes. rolling back routing weight changes now.
alex: note: customer impact — a handful (~7) of customers with large streaming sessions experienced reconnects. SRE note: no data loss reported, reconnects handled by clients.
priya: action items: 1) rollback heuristic (done in eu-west-1) 2) apply avoid rule (done) 3) throttle hotkey or apply rate-limit on hot shard 4) run a root-cause triage doc after stable.
sam: I’ve applied a temporary rate-limit at the ingress for the top offending keyspace: `ingress.rate_limit.set(keyspace=ks_hot42, rps=10)`
emma: sampling shows hot keyspace requests dropped in queue depth quickly. p99 trending down to 1.4s now.
ops-bot: rollback global promotion canceled by alex at 12:26 to avoid rollback ripples; eu-west-1 will remain at previous stable profile while we observe.
ajordan: please capture the routing decisions for a few sample traces (trace ids: t-1a2b, t-1a2c) and attach to incident doc.
emma: uploaded traces and heatmaps to the incident folder: /incidents/4612345678/artifacts
alex: prepping a short customer communication draft. Priya, want to own the sent message? it should say transient latency spike, root cause is routing heuristic promoted too aggressively, mitigation applied.
priya: I’ll draft. include instructions for customers to opt into graceful reconnect strategies for streaming SDK.
sam: monitoring window for (SLO) p99 breach: continue 30min. will escalate to sev1 if p99 > 2.5s for more than 10m.
alex: current status at 12:33: p99=1.35s, p95=210ms, streaming stall events per min down 70% vs peak. closing page but leaving thread open for postmortem.
priya: notes for postmortem: rollout gating was too coarse; need canary rollback automation and per-hotkey detection to avoid global routing heuristic promos. add eval: simulate hotkey pattern in canary tests.
emma: adding a telemetry task: compute per-shard queue depth anomaly and trigger canary hold if >X for 1m.
ops-bot: INCIDENT STATE UPDATE: mitigations applied: avoid backend zb-89, ingress rate-limit for ks_hot42, rollback eu-west-1 heuristic. Monitoring.
alex: thanks team. if p99 stays below threshold for 30min we mark resolved. leaving bridge for another 10m.
priya: tagging product for customer impact follow-up: @product. Also schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
sam: created follow-up ticket INF-2378: router-lb-heuristic-hotkey-fallback. assigned to eng-runtime.
emma: final note: captured heap/gc profiles from lb hosts around spike window; upload in artifacts. may be useful if backend queueing wasn't purely routing policy.
alex: resolved: monitoring stable at 12:50. closing live mitigation. follow-up: postmortem doc and mitigation plan assigned.
